ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText:
This is the third or forth Weber I  have owned. This one is obviously the result of trying to cheapen the product through foreign manufacturing. One-they have gone to one handle not two. This provides less places to hang BBQ utensils. It also makes it difficult to move if it has been recently used and is hot. Two-the lid is not as tough as in the past. My new lid slide off the back, landed in the grass and has deformed so I have to push it aggressively for it to seat to the base. (My old one hit the grass numerous times with no issues.) Three-the coating they are using is also cheaper. Where the one handle is tack welded onto the base it is rusting after two months (I got it for Christmas) My old grill is still in the edge of the yard and after nine years there is no rust at either of the two handles. Lastly-On my previous grill I could put the lid on and leave a crescent moon opening by leaving the lid ajar-it provided for another option for heat retention. This unit, if you try that the lid slides off-therefore hitting the grass and deforming the lid. It is also obvious that they are trying to hide the country of manufacture-the aluminium shield at the adjustable vent says"engineered in Palatine, IL" not manufactured in the USA. 
It is a sad epitaph to a once superior company and product.
Results.Title: Not what they used to be

Results.ReviewText: This is the 3rd 22" Weber Kettle Grill I have owned since 1970. I purchased the first one in September 1975 and it lasted until May 1996., and I still have the owners manual for it. The Second one lasted until December 2023, and Number 3 was purchased in December 2023. I can smoke anything I like on my .. I have looked at pellet grills, but the expense is too much for me, so I stick with a winner price wise and for what I can do with it. I love cooking indirect, because it is the easiest way to  cook and smoke the meats and vegetables you like. I love Weber Grills and want to add a cast iron grill to it for better searing of meats. One day I will probably quit being so tight with my money and get a Weber Pellet Grill but for now I will happily cook on my Weber. I feel you can own a Weber Product and have the best or you can own one of the rest. The review title says it best for me. The more things (Grills) that change, the more I stay the same.
Results.Title: The more things change the more they stay the same

Results.ReviewText: The new design better in some ways, but I miss the back handle for wheeling control. my old premium Weber kettle rusted out at lid handle and bottom vent, can't't get damped enough. The new vent design has notches that make draft control better. Legs now get firmly attached and don't fall out when wheeling, as the old designed legs do; but one leg socket was dented in during shipping, so the ash bucket holder needed a lot of hammering to get that one distorted socket to fit. I don't think the new thermostat in lid is necessary. I'll still use the 23-year-old Weber for smoking foods with smaller fires, but it's good to have the new one, which damps down so well I can reuse unburned charcoal.
Results.Title: Mostly improved new premium design

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
